inspiration.observed_pattern: A recursive CTE splits each space-delimited text value into ordered words, a second CTE normalizes each word, and GROUP_CONCAT reassembles the transformed words in ordinal order.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Rewritten as an independently authored shipment-message normalizer with message IDs, a slash-separated output format, fixed mixed-case phrases, and deterministic message ordering.

fixture_notes: Messages contain multi-word mixed-case text and a one-word message; the report preserves each original message and rebuilds title-cased fragments with a slash separator.
determinism_notes: Message IDs and text literals are fixed, recursion advances by one ordinal per fragment, GROUP_CONCAT orders by ordinal, and the final report orders by message ID. No clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent connections are used.
setup: CREATE TABLE shipment_messages (message_id INT PRIMARY KEY, message_text VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL)
INSERT INTO shipment_messages VALUES (901, 'north WIND depot'), (902, 'MIXED Case signal'), (903, 'solo'), (904, 'east gate beacon')

steps.sql: WITH RECURSIVE fragments AS (SELECT message_id, message_text, SUBSTRING_INDEX(message_text, ' ', 1) AS fragment, CASE WHEN INSTR(message_text, ' ') = 0 THEN '' ELSE SUBSTRING(message_text, INSTR(message_text, ' ') + 1) END AS tail, 1 AS ordinal FROM shipment_messages UNION ALL SELECT message_id, message_text, SUBSTRING_INDEX(tail, ' ', 1) AS fragment, CASE WHEN INSTR(tail, ' ') = 0 THEN '' ELSE SUBSTRING(tail, INSTR(tail, ' ') + 1) END AS tail, ordinal + 1 FROM fragments WHERE tail <> ''), normalized AS (SELECT message_id, message_text, ordinal, CONCAT(UPPER(SUBSTRING(fragment, 1, 1)), LOWER(SUBSTRING(fragment, 2, 255))) AS normalized_fragment FROM fragments) SELECT message_id, message_text AS original_text, GROUP_CONCAT(normalized_fragment ORDER BY ordinal SEPARATOR ' / ') AS normalized_text FROM normalized GROUP BY message_id, message_text ORDER BY message_id
